title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
slides: Creators relied on AI for Spotlight, but now what?
Snapchat changes its reward system for Spotlight posts.
Fully AI-generated clips no longer qualify for bonuses.
Authentic, human-created content now gets prioritized instead.
Review your strategy: blend human creativity with AI tools now.
thread_text:
1. AI Creators Left in the Dust

Snapchat's new reward system quietly disqualifies fully AI-generated Spotlight clips from bonuses.

2. The New Spotlight Rules

Authentic, human-created content now gets priority in the algorithm, shifting the platform's focus.

3. Why the Sudden Shift?

Snapchat is likely reacting to audience fatigue with AI slop, pushing creators back to originality.

4. The Hybrid Advantage

Creators blending AI tools with human creativity are now the ones most likely to qualify for rewards.

5. Time to Rethink Your Workflow

Test a human-edited AI draft on your next Spotlight post this week. Does it earn more than pure AI?

instagram.caption:
Snapchat just stopped paying for fully AI-made Spotlight clips.

The bonus program now skips 100% AI-generated posts, favoring human-made ones. Creators who leaned on automation are cut off, while the algorithm pushes authentic work 📉.

If you used pure AI for Spotlight, your earnings likely drop to zero. But hybrid content—AI drafts with human editing—still qualifies ✂️.

What’s your next post: pure AI, or a human-AI mix? Run one test this week and compare results.
